# A project with no forge refuses a workflow with a merge step, at the position of the step, and the run starts nothing.
isolate

subst config/projects/local.hcl

exitcode 1 obeereal check workflow --project local flow/merge.hcl
stderr 'merge\.hcl:3:1: step `merge\.ship` needs a forge, and project `local` has none\. Set `forge = "github"` in the project file, or remove the step\.'

exec obeereal item add local ship-it --title 'Ship it' --body-file body.txt

exitcode 1 obeereal run ship-it local --workflow flow/merge.hcl
stderr 'merge\.hcl:3:1: step `merge\.ship` needs a forge'

# The refusal comes before the claim: no claim row, no run, and no folder of the engine.
noclaims local
! exists state/dbos.db
! exists state/engine.lock

-- body.txt --
Ship the change.
-- config/projects/local.hcl --
source      = "@WORK@/origin"
base_branch = "main"
gate        = "true"
-- flow/merge.hcl --
workflow "w" {}
gate "check" {}
merge "ship" {
  head  = gate.check.head
  merge = false
}
